basic_info.description: Own a piece of San Francisco's storied past. Originally constructed in the 1940s (some reports say 1932) as the Field-Ernst Envelope Factory, this architecturally rich building was reimagined in 1996 into a boutique collection of live-work lofts  blending industrial charm with contemporary living.    Residence #305 offers two spacious bedrooms and two beautifully upgraded bathrooms, set within a layout designed for both comfort and entertaining. The modern kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring premium appliances including a Samsung refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, DCS 6-burner gas stove with 36'' oven, and a powerful Venta-hood commercial-grade vent system  ideal for home cooking and hosting.    Additional highlights include one-car parking, private storage, in-home Samsung washer and dryer, and the rare potential to add a rooftop deck for private outdoor enjoyment.    Smart home upgrades include a Ring doorbell, Insteon lighting, Adobe alarm system, and CAT 5 internet wiring  offering enhanced convenience and connectivity.    Situated in the vibrant Yerba Buena district, you'll be just moments from world-class dining, shopping, museums, and easy freeway access  all while living in a space that honors the city's architectural legacy.
